# Copilot workspace instructions

[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) is the canonical contract. Follow it for every request.

Before non-trivial work, initialize local state when needed. Read `.agent/local/ACTIVE_TASK.md`, `.agent/local/MEMORY.md`, `.agent/TOOLBOX.md`, and only relevant decisions and skills.

For reconciliation, also read `.agent/local/RECONCILIATION.md` and `.agent/DB_TOOL_CONTRACT.md`.

Never put company-specific information in tracked files.
